title: Variant Contrastboard & Rollback Advisor: per-route diffs, trace-linked divergence, and automated rollback suggestions
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a 'Variant Contrastboard' in the Console that lets operators compare two or more rollout cohorts (canary vs baseline, A/B variants, shadow vs live) across per-route metrics, latency/quality distributions, trace-linked failure signals, and a recommended rollback action. The board should surface both aggregated diffs and bucketed heatmaps, enable deep links into traces and sample inputs, and provide an automated 'Rollback Advisor' that combines SLO checks, statistical divergence heuristics, and business rules to propose actions (no-op, pause, rollback, scale-up).
acceptance_criteria: Contrastboard UI shows side-by-side cohort comparison for selected route(s) and time window

Numeric diffs include absolute, relative change, and confidence indicator for: p50/p90 latency, error rate, generation token rate, avg tokens per request, rejection rate, rerank quality metric (when available)
Heatmap view showing per-route + per-model sequence-length-normalized delta for latency and perplexity-like quality signals
Each metric cell includes a link to: (a) trace view filtered to cohort traffic, (b) sample request / response examples (redacted), and (c) associated log/alert rules
Rollback Advisor returns one of: keep, pause, rollback, partial-rollback and includes rationale + top contributing signals
Advisor integrates with existing rollout API to propose a safe rollback plan (variant percentage, affected routes) but does not perform changes without explicit operator approval
Policy editor exists for admin to configure thresholds and weighting used by the Advisor (SLO thresholds, min-traffic requirement, statistical test settings)

Performance: dashboard queries complete within 3s for 30-minute windows on a baseline 1M requests/day tenant (using current telemetry infra), with graceful fallback to cached snapshot for heavier loads
RBAC: only users with rollout:manage permission can trigger advisor-approved rollbacks; read-only users can view and annotate
Automated e2e tests and integration tests added: UI snapshot, backend metric diff correctness on synthetic datasets, and advisor decision unit tests
design_notes: UI: two-pane comparison with universal metric table + route filter; secondary panes for heatmap and trace list
Statistical approach: use sequential Bayesian delta estimation for metric lift with minimum traffic guardrail to reduce false positives
Advisor: weighted score combining SLO violations (high weight), error-rate spike (high), latency regressions (medium), quality regressions (medium), telemetry noise factor (low)
Privacy: sample requests must be redacted per PII policy; only show hashed identifiers and truncated prompts unless customer opt-in
Data retention: cohort snapshots stored for 30 days by default for diffs and replayability; preview mode uses short-lived cache
Trade-offs: precise p-values require heavier historical computation; we prefer fast approximate Bayesian credible intervals for interactive UX
UX: Add an 'Explain' hover on advisor output showing top-3 contributing signals and a simple natural-language rationale
decisions: Use pre-existing rollout/cohort APIs as the canonical data source rather than materializing cohorts in a new DB
Implement Bayesian sequential estimator server-side to compute lift summaries; front-end requests summary vectors only
Advisor will be advisory-only in Phase 1 (no auto-actuation); phase 2 will allow gated auto-rollback with explicit customer opt-in
Heatmap aggregation will use logarithmic binning for sequence length to avoid dominance of long-tail examples
